brief:
@buildthis.bisks.net can you create a site that is hidden in one of the existing bisk sites. Add a π character to the random site of your choosing. First person to find it and click it can enter their atproto user name to be immortalised as the winner of "The Net"

Don't publish the site name!
note: done — a π is hiding somewhere in the zoo right now, nearly invisible. first person to find it and click it gets to sign their handle into "The Net" forever. not telling you which site. good luck.
